summary: Backend-only regression + feature test for get_config() merge robustness and /api/today round-trip fields. 40/41 pytest tests pass. Backend healthy, poller running, no startup crash. All requested features verified via live curls against public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL.

minor.issue: TestPoller.test_poller_writes_snapshots is inherently flaky: uses 1h rolling window so 20s wait can drop old snapshots faster than new ones arrive (36 -> 35). Poller itself is verified running via /api/diagnostics/run. Test-logic issue, not app bug.

action_items: Optional: Harden TestPoller by comparing db.snapshots absolute counts (via a debug endpoint) or by using a wider history range (24h) to avoid rolling-window drops. Not blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: get_config() merge is now drift-safe (iterates DEFAULT_CONFIG.items()); confirmed forecast key merges even when stored doc lacks it.
PUT /api/config with partial payload (e.g. {demo_mode:true}) correctly retains all nested defaults incl. forecast — no KeyError.
/api/today correctly returns battery_charge_kwh, battery_discharge_kwh, round_trip_pct; round_trip_pct clamped 0..100 (verified 0.0 with only 0.047 kWh charge < 0.05 threshold, correct behavior).
poller_loop writes battery_charge_w/battery_discharge_w into snapshots — verified via /api/history point structure.
server.py is 1144 lines — exceeds the 700-line guideline; recommend splitting integrations (mqtt/influx), forecast, and diagnostics into separate modules for maintainability.
@app.on_event startup/shutdown is deprecated in FastAPI (warnings emitted); consider migrating to lifespan handlers.
seed_data_creation: None. Only used PUT /api/config toggle test which is restored by existing test suite.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend on preview URL is healthy, demo_mode=True, poller writing every 15s. get_config() merge fix verified for all nested keys incl. forecast. TestPoller flakiness is known — see minor issue.
rca of the issue: Original LXC startup crash root-caused: DEFAULT_CONFIG lacked 'forecast' while merge loop was hardcoded to a fixed list containing 'forecast', causing KeyError on empty stored doc. Fix iterates DEFAULT_CONFIG.items() so the merge is always aligned with actual defaults. Verified: even when stored config lacks 'forecast'/'influx', GET/PUT return complete merged nested dicts without KeyError.
